title: Release safety-net triage notebook
content:
Goal / context:
- Quick scratchpad for the partial rollback attempt on 2026-03-11 (canary failure on svc-encoder).
- Keep commands + raw snippets so we can reconstruct later.
- Not a runbook; doing exploratory triage before formalizing steps.

Timeline (short):
- 2026-03-11 09:12 UTC: Canary started showing increased 5xx rate (cpu stable, latency spike).
- 09:18 UTC: Alert -> pager. Canary traffic 5% -> errors spiked to ~18% on /v1/encode.
- 09:21 UTC: Scoped to revision v2026-03-10-encoder-7 (image sha256:abc123def456).
- 09:35 UTC: Rolled back canary traffic to previous image v2026-03-09-encoder-3 (sha256:ffbbee1122) for mitigation.
- 09:40 UTC: Errors dropped to ~1.2%. Need root cause and safe rollback guidance.

Commands tried (raw):
- k get pods -n prod -l app=svc-encoder -o wide\  # confirm pods and node spread
- kubectl rollout history deployment/svc-encoder -n prod
- kubectl describe pod svc-encoder-5bb7c -n prod  # saw imagePullBackOff on one replica earlier
- kubectl logs svc-encoder-5bb7c -n prod --previous | tail -n 80
  -> time="2026-03-11T09:14:36Z" level=error msg="failed to allocate shard: mmap failed: invalid argument"
- gcloud artifacts docker images list gcr.io/redwood-prod/svc-encoder --limit=20 --sort-by=~TIMESTAMP
  -> latest: v2026-03-10-encoder-7 @ sha256:abc123def456 (built by CI #3412)
- docker run --rm --entrypoint /bin/sh gcr.io/redwood-prod/svc-encoder@sha256:abc123def456 -c 'ldd /usr/local/bin/encoder || true'
  -> ldd: /usr/local/bin/encoder: No such file or directory  # suspicious
- docker run --rm gcr.io/redwood-prod/svc-encoder@sha256:ffbbee1122 --version
  -> Encoder 2.7.1
- git rev-parse --short HEAD (in infra/image-builds/svc-encoder) -> a1b2c3d4
- gh pr view 842 --json commits -q .commits[0].oid -> 7e8f9a0b  # matches CI metadata for build 3412

Raw error snippets captured:
- "failed to allocate shard: mmap failed: invalid argument"
- "entrypoint binary not found: ldd: /usr/local/bin/encoder: No such file or directory"
- kubelet: image verification failed: signature mismatch

Hypotheses (initial, ordered by perceived likelihood):
1) Bad image push: CI pushed an incomplete image (missing binary) or wrong image tagged as encoder-7. Evidence: ldd shows binary missing in shaabc123.
2) Build pipeline regression: new build step changed artifact layout (moved binary path), runtime expects /usr/local/bin but image contains /app/encoder.
3) Runtime memmap incompatibility triggered by node kernel/libc mismatch (less likely given missing binary error).
4) Image signed with new signing key and verification failed on some nodes -> intermittent imagePullBackOff and signature messages.

What I validated quickly:
- Pulled the failing image locally (as above) and inspected tree: docker run --rm gcr.io/redwood-prod/svc-encoder@sha256:abc123def456 ls -la / -> top-level missing /usr/local/bin/encoder; there is /workspace/bundle.tar.gz and a README.txt -> looks like CI uploaded build artefacts instead of final image layer.
- CI job #3412 logs (quick grep): "tarball stage -> upload bundle.tar.gz" and then later "pushed image tag v2026-03-10-encoder-7" but no step showing docker build of final image. Suspicious step: "artifact attach" executed before build step finished.
- Compared manifest sizes: abc123def456 image manifest size 12MB vs ffbbee1122 (good) 180MB -> supports truncated/incomplete image.

Immediate rollback notes (what we did):
- kubectl set image deployment/svc-encoder svc-encoder=gcr.io/redwood-prod/svc-encoder@sha256:ffbbee1122 -n prod
- kubectl rollout status deployment/svc-encoder -n prod
- Monitored metrics -> success (errors down).
- Opened emergency PR to CI to block mark of image tags when manifest < 50MB (temp guard).

Suggested longer-term fixes / actions to formalize:
- Add CI gate: verify image contains expected binary paths and ldd output before pushing tag.
- Add artifact size sanity check and manifest validation (reject < 50MB unless flagged).
- Improve release tooling to decouple tag assignment from artifact upload completion. Ensure atomicity.
- Add a canary health check that validates container /usr/local/bin/encoder exists before routing traffic (init container?).

Notes to self / TODOs:
- Follow up with infra/build-team: get exact CI job steps for #3412 and ask why push occurred before build finishing. (Assigned: Evan)
- Add quick script to infra repo to run a post-push smoke test (ldd check + --version). (Assigned: me)
- Draft a short postmortem: timeline, impact, root cause, mitigation, follow-ups. Target draft by 2026-03-14 EOD.
- Check other images built in same pipeline window (CI 3409-3415) for similar truncated artifacts. Scripted check against manifest size.

Scratch commands / snippets to keep:
- gcloud artifacts docker images describe gcr.io/redwood-prod/svc-encoder@sha256:abc123def456 --format=json | jq '.manifest[]?.layers | length'
- skaffold run --default-repo=gcr.io/redwood-prod -n prod  # local repro notes (do not run on prod without guard)
- docker inspect --format='{{.ContainerConfig.Cmd}}' gcr.io/redwood-prod/svc-encoder@sha256:abc123def456 || true

Random observations / brain dump:
- If CI uploaded a tarball layer by mistake, other services in same deploy window might have similar issue -> check releases for other teams.
- Signing/verification errors could be a separate symptomatic issue; correlate with node pool upgrade timestamps (SRE note: nodepool-prod-2 rolled 2026-03-10).
- Might be worth adding a small reproducible test: create minimal image that intentionally lacks binary and ensure detection.

Attachments / links to collect for PM/postmortem:
- CI job 3412 logs (archived): link -> https://ci.internal.redwood/job/3412/console
- PR that triggered build: https://github.com/redwood-inference/service-api/pull/842
- Canary graph snapshot (Datadog): https://app.datadoghq.com/graph/snapshot/abc-encoder-canary-2026-03-11

Quick checklist for next on-call rotation (short):
- If canary errors spike: check image manifest size + contents before diverting traffic.
- If image appears truncated: immediate set-image to prior sha and roll back tag protections in CI.
- Communicate rollback and mark CI pipeline as restricted until fix.

End of scratchpad. Will refine into formal runbook after talking to build infra.
